name: Zenity MCP Gateway
tagline: One control point between every AI agent and every MCP server it connects to
description: Zenity MCP Gateway is now generally available, putting one control point between every AI agent and every Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Every tool call carries a real user identity, is checked against policy before it runs, and is recorded. Zenity hosts the gateway; it works with any MCP client that supports remote MCPs, and it needs nothing installed on endpoints.
pricingDetails: Pricing not published. "Book a demo today."
